tools.name: get_pr
tools.description:
Return one pull request selected by its exact id from list_open_prs.

        The result includes the complete stored pull-request record. A title, URL,
        repository name, or unknown id is rejected rather than guessed.

tools.name: post_pr_comment
tools.description:
Post nonempty body text on the existing pr_id from list_open_prs.

        pr_id is the returned id, not a title or an invented name. Markdown is
        stored exactly as supplied. Returns ok=true and the stored comment,
        including its unique id and pr_id. Missing PRs return ok=false.

tools.name: list_open_prs
tools.description:
List identifying pull-request summaries. Defaults to open PRs.

        status may be open, closed, merged, or null for every status. repo and
        author filter by exact repository name and author key. assignee matches
        the assignees list; reviewer matches the reviewers list. These are separate
        relationships. Omitted filters do not restrict results. The summaries omit
        each pull request's body; use get_pr with an exact id to inspect the body.

pr.title: Emit blocked handoff observations from a retryable worker
pr.author: mira
pr.description: Moves quarterly handoff-observation writes off the readiness path. Queue delivery is at least once, and a job may be retried after a timeout.

files.patch:
def emit_observation(job):
    row = build_report_row(job.handoff, job.failure)
    row["observation_id"] = str(uuid4())
    row["subject_member_id"] = job.handoff.owner_member_id
    quarterly_handoff_observations.insert(row)
    job.ack()

def test_emits_blocked_handoff():
    emit_observation(job)
    assert observations.count() == 1
    assert observations.first().failure_details == job.failure.details

pr.review_notes: No retry or redelivery test is included.

args.body: The row needs a deterministic handoff identity, not a fresh UUID per delivery: upsert on `(team, release_candidate, canonical_package_version)`. That makes a timeout/redelivery update the same quarterly observation, while a different release candidate or package version stays distinct. Keep the operational failure details, but omit `subject_member_id`—the observation is about the handoff, not its owner. Please add coverage that retries/redeliveries do not increase the count, distinct handoff keys remain separate, and the write is durable before the job is acknowledged.
